title: B-AVIBench: Towards Evaluating the Robustness of Large Vision-Language Model on Black-box Adversarial Visual-Instructions
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the robustness of Large Vision-Language Models against adversarial attacks and social biases such as gender, race, and culture. While it includes safety categories like 'violence' and 'hate', it does not specifically benchmark religious content or formal ethical/moral philosophical frameworks.
